title: 第 2 课 · 电源与 GND（地）
summary: GND 到底是什么？为什么每个元件最后都要接到蓝色轨？
description:
【电压是两点之间的差】
电压（voltage）永远是“A 点相对 B 点”高多少伏。说“这个点是 5V”时，省略了“相对谁”——那个默认的参考点就叫 GND（ground，地），规定它是 0 V。

【GND 就是电源的 − 极】
在电池或电源电路里，我们通常把电源的 − 端定义为 GND。所以：电源 + 端 = VCC（比如 +9V），电源 − 端 = GND（0V）。GND 不是“大地”，也不是“电流消失的地方”，它只是电路里大家约定的 0V 参考点。

【电流需要回家的路（return path）】
电流从电源 + 出发，流过元件，最后必须回到电源 −。原理图里画的那个“地”符号（⏚），意思就是“这根线接到电源 − 端”。原理图上可能画了 5 个地符号，它们在实物上全部是同一个节点——在面包板上就是蓝色 − 轨。

【为什么要有电源轨】
几乎每个元件都需要接 VCC 或 GND。把电源接到长长的红 / 蓝轨上，任何一列都能就近取电、就近接地，不用把所有线都拉回电池。

本课：两个 LED 支路共用同一个 VCC（红轨）和同一个 GND（蓝轨）。tests 里还会测量电压：VCC 相对 GND 约 9V；LED 负极就在 GND 上，所以是 0V。

en.title: Lesson 2 · Power and GND (ground)
en.summary: What exactly is GND? Why does every part end up connected to the blue rail?
en.description:
**Voltage is a difference between two points**
A voltage is always "how many volts point A is above point B". When we say "this point is at 5V" we leave out "relative to what". That default reference point is called GND (ground), and by definition it is 0 V.

**GND is the − terminal of the supply**
In battery- or supply-powered circuits we normally define the supply's − terminal as GND. So: supply + = VCC (for example +9V), supply − = GND (0V). GND is not "the earth" and it is not "where the current disappears"; it is simply the 0V reference point everyone in the circuit agrees on.

**Current needs a way home (return path)**
Current leaves the supply's + terminal, flows through the parts, and must finally get back to the supply's − terminal. The ground symbol (⏚) drawn on a schematic means "this wire goes to the supply's − terminal". A schematic may show five ground symbols, but in the real circuit they are all one and the same node; on the breadboard that is the blue − rail.

**Why power rails?**
Almost every part needs a connection to VCC or GND. By connecting the supply to the long red / blue rails, any column can grab power and ground right next to it, instead of running every wire back to the battery.

In this lesson: two LED branches share the same VCC (red rail) and the same GND (blue rail). The tests also measure voltages: VCC is about 9V relative to GND; the LED cathodes sit on GND, so they are at 0V.
steps: Battery + to the red rail at tp1, − to the blue rail at tn1. From now on: the whole red rail = VCC (+9V), the whole blue rail = GND (0V).
First branch: red jumper tp5 → a5, bringing VCC to column 5.
R1 (470Ω) goes between c5 and c8; the red LED1's long lead goes in d8 and its short lead in d10.
Blue jumper a10 → tn10: LED1's cathode goes back to GND. This is its return path.
The second branch is exactly the same, just further right: tp15 → a15, R2 in c15–c18, yellow LED2 long lead d18, short lead d20.
Blue jumper a20 → tn20. Both branches' "grounds" go to the same blue rail: two ground symbols on the schematic are one single GND node in the real circuit.
hints: You don't need to run each branch back to the battery on the red rail: the whole rail is already connected.
If an LED doesn't light, first check that its cathode has a path to the blue rail.

steps.text: 电池 + 接红轨 tp1，− 接蓝轨 tn1。从现在起：整条红轨 = VCC（+9V），整条蓝轨 = GND（0V）。
第一条支路：红色跳线 tp5 → a5，把 VCC 引到第 5 列。
R1（470Ω）插在 c5 和 c8 之间；红色 LED1 的长脚插 d8、短脚插 d10。
蓝色跳线 a10 → tn10：LED1 的负极回到 GND。这就是它的 return path。
第二条支路完全一样，只是换到右边：tp15 → a15，R2 插 c15–c18，黄色 LED2 长脚 d18、短脚 d20。
蓝色跳线 a20 → tn20。两条支路的“地”都接到同一条蓝轨——原理图里两个地符号，实物上就是同一个 GND 节点。

hints: 红轨不需要每条支路都连回电池：整条轨道本来就是通的。
如果某个 LED 不亮，先检查它的负极有没有一条路通到蓝轨。
